data.description:
## Observation

The close precheck (`txn.ensure_ac_boxes_checked`, `txn.ensure_attested_items_valid` via `det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`), the completion verifier prompt (`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md`), and ADR 0043 recognize `[non-codebase]` / `[operator-attested]` only at the START of the checkbox text. A tag anywhere else is silently treated as untagged: no plan-review finding, no close-precheck message, and the verifier judges the item by the codebase bar.

Measured on the store on 2026-11-01: 28 AC checkbox lines in 22 tickets end with the tag (27 already ticked; fleece-grave-noolbenger's sweep criterion is open). 736 lines in 328 tickets carry it at the start.

## Expected

An author who writes the tag in the wrong place is told so, at plan-review time (when moving it is cheap) and at the close precheck, rather than discovering it through an unexpected codebase-bar FAIL.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A checkbox line that contains the exact tag anywhere other than the start produces a plan-review finding naming the required position.
- [ ] The close precheck's unchecked-AC message names a misplaced tag on an offending line.
- [ ] Tests cover a trailing tag, a mid-line tag, and prose that merely mentions the tag in backticks (no finding).
data.title: A [non-codebase] tag that is not at the start of the checkbox text is silently ignored
